text:
Type: armless upholstered swivel desk chair
Use: working at a desk; home office, study, bedroom
Style: classic, contemporary, Scandinavian
Materials: smooth upholstery with button tufting, padded seat and back, dark grey steel five-star base, plastic casters
Colors: off-white, cream white, dark grey
Shape: tall rounded rectangular back with four tufted buttons and stitched lines, wide padded seat, armless, slim column on a five-star base with casters, medium visual weight
Feel: soft, clean, elegant, comfortable
Goes with: white or light wood desks, pale walls, grey accents; Scandinavian, classic or feminine home offices

product.name: LILLHJDEN
product.description: You sit comfortably since the chair is adjustable in height.
